from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, re
from PIL import Image

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = base / 'archive-repo'
freeze = json.loads((base / 'final-freeze.json').read_text())
manifest = json.loads((base / 'archive-expected-paths.json').read_text())
baseline = json.loads((base / 'archive-baseline-tree.json').read_text())
prefix = freeze['prefix']
expected_base_tree = '598ca77bd0635e418e7eced4db6384658f9687d4'
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def blob(data): return hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()

def tree_identity(leaves):
    root = {}
    for e in leaves:
        parts = e['path'].split('/')
        node = root
        for part in parts[:-1]: node = node.setdefault(part, {})
        assert parts[-1] not in node, 'Duplicate tree path'
        node[parts[-1]] = (e['mode'], e['sha'])
    def build(node):
        body = bytearray()
        for name, value in sorted(node.items(), key=lambda pair: (pair[0] + ('/' if isinstance(pair[1], dict) else '')).encode()):
            mode, ident = ('40000', build(value)) if isinstance(value, dict) else value
            body += mode.encode() + b' ' + name.encode() + b'\0' + bytes.fromhex(ident)
        return hashlib.sha1(b'tree ' + str(len(body)).encode() + b'\0' + body).hexdigest()
    return build(root)

issues = []
baseline_leaves = [x for x in baseline['tree'] if x['type'] != 'tree']
assert not baseline['truncated']
assert len(baseline_leaves) == 4144
assert tree_identity(baseline_leaves) == expected_base_tree == baseline['sha'] == manifest['base_tree']
baseline_paths = {x['path'] for x in baseline_leaves}
actual_paths = {str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in repo.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
expected_paths = {x['path'] for x in manifest['files']}
assert actual_paths == expected_paths, 'Unmanifested or missing files in candidate'
assert not (actual_paths & baseline_paths), 'Would overwrite a baseline path'
assert all(x.startswith(prefix + '/') for x in actual_paths), 'Out-of-scope file'
assert not any(x.startswith('.github/') for x in actual_paths)
by_sha256, by_git = {}, {}
for row in manifest['files']:
    p = repo / row['path']; data = p.read_bytes()
    assert row['mode'] == '100644' and row['type'] == 'blob'
    assert len(data) == row['bytes']
    assert sha(data) == row['sha256'] and blob(data) == row['git_blob_sha']
    if p.suffix.lower() in {'.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg'}:
        assert not data.startswith(b'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/')
        im = Image.open(p); im.verify()
    by_sha256.setdefault(sha(data), []).append(row['path'])
    by_git.setdefault(blob(data), []).append(row['path'])

combined = baseline_leaves + [{'path': x['path'], 'mode': x['mode'], 'type': x['type'], 'sha': x['git_blob_sha']} for x in manifest['files']]
candidate = tree_identity(combined)
assert candidate == manifest['candidate_tree']
all_git = {x['sha'] for x in combined}
required_exact_documents = [freeze['requirements'], freeze['final_independent_visual_review'], freeze['root_visual_review'], freeze['root_input_verification'], freeze['input_index'], freeze['counter_final_handoff']] + freeze['generation_index_bindings'] + freeze['all_attempt_reviews']
required_exact_documents += [{'path': 'final-freeze.json', 'sha256': sha((base / 'final-freeze.json').read_bytes())}]
for e in required_exact_documents:
    assert sha((base / e['path']).read_bytes()) == e['sha256']
    assert e['sha256'] in by_sha256, 'Missing exact frozen document: ' + e['path']

input_proof = json.loads((base / 'root-input-verification.json').read_text())
assert input_proof['status'] == 'PASS' and len(input_proof['images']) == 17
for ident, entry in input_proof['images'].items():
    original = base / entry['path']
    target = repo / prefix / 'attempts' / (ident + '.png')
    assert sha(original.read_bytes()) == entry['sha256'] and blob(original.read_bytes()) == entry['git_blob_sha']
    assert target.read_bytes() == original.read_bytes()
    inv = input_proof['invocations'][ident]
    assert sha((base / inv['prompt_path']).read_bytes()) == inv['prompt_sha256']
    assert (repo / prefix / 'prompts' / (ident + '.txt')).read_bytes() == (base / inv['prompt_path']).read_bytes()
    for ref in inv['ordered_references']:
        data = (base / ref['path']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(data) == ref['sha256'] and blob(data) in all_git, 'Unpreserved actual image input'

for entry in freeze['selected']:
    p = repo / prefix / 'selected' / (entry['series_id'] + '.png')
    assert p.read_bytes() == (base / entry['source_path']).read_bytes()
    assert blob(p.read_bytes()) == entry['git_blob_sha']
    assert list(Image.open(p).size) == entry['native_size']

crop_count = 0
for review_entry in freeze['all_attempt_reviews']:
    r = json.loads((base / review_entry['path']).read_text())
    if r.get('crop_provenance_sha256'):
        assert r['crop_provenance_sha256'] in by_sha256, 'Missing raw crop provenance'
    for crop in r.get('crop_evidence', []):
        assert sha((base / crop['path']).read_bytes()) == crop['sha256']
        assert crop['sha256'] in by_sha256, 'Missing actual critic crop'
        crop_count += 1

# Retain contextual review inputs as well as generation references, including
# the prior style guide found by the separate critic's package review.
resolver = json.loads((repo / prefix / 'review-input-resolver.json').read_text())
baseline_by_path = {x['path']: x for x in baseline_leaves}
context_sources = []
style_audit = json.loads((base / 'reviews/critic-preliminary-style-audit.json').read_text())
context_sources.extend([style_audit['style_authority'], style_audit['style_guide']])
for name in ['critic-fence-gate-source-audit.json', 'critic-counter-source-audit.json']:
    context_sources.extend(json.loads((base / 'reviews' / name).read_text())['sources'])
for entry in context_sources:
    p = base.parent / entry['path']; data = p.read_bytes()
    assert sha(data) == entry['sha256']
    paths = resolver['sha256_to_archive_paths'].get(entry['sha256'], [])
    urls = resolver['sha256_to_immutable_existing_repository_urls'].get(entry['sha256'], [])
    assert paths or urls, 'Unresolved contextual review input: ' + entry['path']
    for path in paths:
        assert (repo / prefix / path).read_bytes() == data
    for url in urls:
        marker = '/blob/' + freeze['base_commit'] + '/'
        assert marker in url, 'Context URL is not bound to the immutable baseline'
        old_path = url.split(marker, 1)[1]
        assert baseline_by_path[old_path]['sha'] == blob(data)

navigation_links = 0
for name in ['README.md', 'GALLERY.md']:
    p = repo / prefix / name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\s)]+)\)', p.read_text()):
        if link.startswith(('https://', 'http://', '#')): continue
        target = (p.parent / link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        assert target.exists(), 'Broken new navigation link: ' + link
        navigation_links += 1

report = {'schema_version': 1, 'reviewer': 'root independent concrete package audit', 'status': 'PASS_PREPUBLICATION', 'score': 10,
          'final_freeze_sha256': sha((base / 'final-freeze.json').read_bytes()),
          'requirements_sha256': freeze['requirements_sha256'], 'base_commit': freeze['base_commit'], 'base_tree': expected_base_tree,
          'baseline_leaves_reconstructed_and_unchanged': len(baseline_leaves), 'candidate_tree': candidate,
          'candidate_manifest_sha256': sha((base / 'archive-expected-paths.json').read_bytes()),
          'new_file_count': len(manifest['files']), 'generated_originals_exact': 17, 'selected_same_blob_aliases': 9,
          'frozen_exact_document_checks': len(required_exact_documents), 'actual_review_crop_checks': crop_count,
          'contextual_review_inputs_resolved': len(context_sources),
          'navigation_links_resolved': navigation_links, 'all_actual_input_blobs_preserved': True,
          'all_new_files_limited_to_prefix': True, 'issues': issues,
          'fresh_baseline_observation': 'Root independently fetched matching untruncated baseline tree through GitHub API; file leaves independently reconstruct its exact Git identity.',
          'claim_boundary': 'Concrete candidate package only; publication and fresh remote branch/tree readback remain pending.'}
(base / 'root-package-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
